explanation: This component is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and is active only at GO, where its value rises with how many recent trials went unrewarded: about 0-3 after a reward (falling toward 0 during long rewarded streaks, especially late in the episode), about 4-7 after one unrewarded trial, and 8-10 after two or more unrewarded trials in a row. It is also high (about 10) at GO on trial 0-1 or right after a reversal, and it ignores which action was chosen and whether the transition was common or rare.
